Resume Chatbot: a walkthrough

Compare your resume with the jobs you are considering, see where the gaps are, and prepare for the interview. This tour follows the main flow with fictional demo data; the answers and scores come from the real model.

1Add your resume

Upload a PDF, Word, Markdown or text file, or paste the text. The text is extracted and saved, so you add it once and reuse it in any chat.

2Add the jobs you are considering

Add as many postings as you like. This demo has three: a close match, a stretch, and a long shot. Each job needs a name you will recognise.

3Start a chat

Choose a resume and the jobs you want to compare. The order you tick them gives each job a number, so you can ask about “Job #1” or “Job #2”.

4Ask about your fit

Ask in plain language: what skills you are missing, how your experience lines up, or which job to go for. Answers use your resume and the postings, and say so when something is not in your resume instead of guessing.

5Score each job

Beyond the conversation, a score gives a structured read of one job against your resume. Open one to see how the number was reached.

Generated 2026-10-01 from the running app. Demo data is fictional.
